fields.description: Binghatti Spectre is a two-tower mixed-use development in Al Jaddaf, Dubai, combining studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments with offices and retail. Its published plans include conventional apartments and a larger three-bedroom layout with an open terrace and pool.

overview: The developer places Spectre near DEWA Headquarters in Al Jaddaf, with connections to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Oud Metha.
research.locationNote: Al Jaddaf, Dubai, near DEWA Headquarters according to the developer. The project’s residential, office and retail uses share one development; selecting an address does not establish a guaranteed view or journey time.
research.priceNote: The official project hero showed AED 774,999 on 31 October 2026; Bayut rounds the project launch guide to AED 775,000. A headline starting price does not identify a currently available apartment. Confirm the home, floor, size and written terms.
research.paymentNote: Bayut publishes 10% down payment, 40% before handover and 50% at handover. This is a secondary project summary, not a dated developer calendar. Obtain the selected-unit agreement, due dates and any applicable offer conditions before relying on the split.
research.handoverNote: Bayut forecasts Q4 2028. The retrieved developer page, brochure and facts pack did not establish a current contractual completion date. The forecast remains attributed and the headline unconfirmed.

facts.label: Published tower mix
facts.value: Tower A: 508 apartments. Tower B: 204 apartments and 235 offices. The scheme also lists 19 ground-floor retail shops. Published counts are not available inventory.

facts.label: Configuration discrepancy
facts.value: The facts pack gives 4 basements + ground + 3 podiums + 26 office/residential floors + mechanical + roof. The webpage FAQ instead describes 3 basements and 2 podiums with a plaza. Confirm the approved building configuration.

unresolved: Published areas include balconies. Confirm the selected home’s contractual measurement and specifications; the Type 02 three-bedroom pool terrace is already included in its total.
Office and retail unit sizes, charges and commercial sale terms were not established for an individual unit.

No current dated developer payment sheet, contractual completion date, service/cooling charges or live stock feed was verified. Obtain the exact offer and agreement; no tax exemption, visa entitlement or investment return is promised.
